title: HARPS3 for a roboticized Isaac Newton Telescope
what_was_studied: Spectrograph design and ten-year Terra Hunting Experiment concept
numerical_result: The design aims at about 0.10 m/s instrumental precision and nightly sampling of a selected stellar sample
remaining_question: A design aim and survey simulation are not achieved on-sky performance

title: HARPS3 instrument and Terra Hunting Experiment
what_was_studied: Instrument architecture, survey concept and development history
numerical_result: The project describes a stabilized visible spectrograph for the refurbished robotic INT
remaining_question: The page does not provide achieved stellar precision

title: ING call for proposals semester 2026B
what_was_studied: Integration, expected commissioning and proposed open-time access
numerical_result: The 23 February call described integration in progress and 2026B open time on a shared-risk basis
remaining_question: Shared-risk access must not be relabelled as completed commissioning

title: WEAVE and HARPS3 latest news
